title: Paul Gordan and Clebsch-Gordan: Source-Witnessed LaTeX and Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Gordan / Clebsch-Gordan working-edition record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record holds source-witnessed LaTeX and English translation working drafts, scans, and audit ledgers for Gordan/Clebsch-Gordan material.

Latest update. Adds Gordan_Abel27_p343_355_DE_EN_20260612.zip, covering source pp.343-355 / printed pp.321-333 of Theorie der Abelschen Functionen. The tranche completes sections 91-93 and the authorial text of the book, includes current German/English TeX/PDF, cumulative German/English TeX/PDF through source p355, source and PNG witnesses through p362, equation audits, render checks, build logs, and checksums. Source pp.356-362 are retained as blank/end/cover scan witnesses only.

Quality note. These are package-audited, source-witnessed working drafts, not certified critical editions. Scans and zoom crops control mathematical readings; OCR scaffolds are non-authoritative gap/comparison witnesses only. Verify important formulas, notation, and theorem statements against the included source witnesses.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Adds Gordan_Abel27_p343_355_DE_EN_20260612.zip, extending Clebsch--Gordan Theorie der Abelschen Functionen through source pp.343-355 / printed pp.321-333 and completing sections 91-93 plus the authorial text of the book. The package includes current German/English TeX/PDF, cumulative German/English TeX/PDF through source p355, scan witnesses through p362, equation audits, render checks, build logs, and checksums. Source pp.356-362 are retained as blank/end/cover scan witnesses only. Package-audited working draft only; scans and zoom crops control formula readings, OCR is a non-authoritative comparator, and this is not a certified critical edition.
